stem: A pump alarm clears after one permitted reset, returns eight minutes later, clears again, then returns while Zone 3 remains dry. Which maintenance handoff is most useful?
choices: Alarm reset three times; probably a failed motor

Pump P-12, Room F3: alarm at 13:02, 13:10, and 13:18; permitted reset temporarily cleared the first two alarms; Zone 3 remained dry; no protected access performed; irrigation impact and current status escalated
Reset succeeded twice, so no further record is needed
rationale: A time-ordered fault record preserves reproducible evidence: asset, location, recurrence, permitted checks, process impact, and current status. It is more useful than a vague label or unsupported root-cause claim.
